data.one_liner: Tizen implementation of the connectivity_plus plugin for checking network status.
data.what_it_does: Provides the Tizen platform implementation for the connectivity_plus plugin, allowing Flutter apps to discover network connectivity status on Tizen devices. It surfaces whether the device is connected via wifi, mobile, ethernet, or has no connection.
use_when: You are building a Flutter application targeting Tizen devices and need to check network connectivity.
You are already using connectivity_plus and need to add Tizen OS support.
avoid_when: Your Flutter app does not target Tizen.
You require multiple network connection types simultaneously or specifically need vpn/satellite distinction on Tizen.
strengths: Enables connectivity_plus support on Tizen devices.
weaknesses: Not an endorsed implementation, so it must be added manually alongside connectivity_plus.
Multiple connections are not supported; only the currently connected type is returned.
VPN and satellite connection types are not supported by the underlying Tizen API.
data.setup_notes: Add both connectivity_plus and connectivity_plus_tizen to pubspec.yaml, and add the http://tizen.org/privilege/network.get privilege under the <manifest> section in tizen-manifest.xml.

alternatives.name: connectivity_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: The core plugin interface that this package implements for cross-platform connectivity checks.
